content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11020 If in a call of IncrementCounter an error happens during the execution of an alarm action, e.g. E_OS_LIMIT caused by a Task activation, IncrementCounter shall call the error hook(s), but the IncrementCounter service itself shall return E_OK .
